values: Existing result: Akram Aldroubi, Carlos Cabrelli, Christopher Heil, Keri Kornelson and Ursula Molter, Invariance of a Shift-Invariant Space, JFAA16(1) (2010),60–75, Theorem5.2; arXiv0804.1597v3 (21Dec2008), same paper DOI10.48550/arXiv.0804.1597. Full exact characterization for every finite L2(R) family and fixed positive integer n: its norm-closed integer-shift span S satisfies T_(1/n)S=S iff rank G=sum_k rank G_k a.e. Covers Aldroubi OWR10/2004 pp487–488, problem30000035/OWR-720-001, including G=I and the scalar Fourier-support partition. Earlier Chui–Sun2003 cross-frequency orthogonality credited. Use closure(P_kS) before invariance; fresh independent proof reconstruction verifies the rank theorem despite a closure presentation defect in arXiv v3. Original qualitative preference for a similar useful characterization independent of easy consequences is not formally certified; no general component-support-only test, finite numerical decision algorithm or separate approximate-invariance result claimed. Authenticated primary v3 proof/TeX, original source and journal DOI metadata inspected; publisher PDF endpoint returned HTML, so no final journal-PDF body comparison. This AI-assisted internal review is unrefereed, without external human peer review or proof-assistant certification; it makes no claim about the source authors’ AI use, worldwide priority or new discovery. https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1233
